title: 开挖安全小测验（国内版）

author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/29_Excavation Safety Quiz Test Your Safety Knowledge Excavation Safety Quiz Excavat（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 测验规则：十题八对才过
points.K3: 深基坑支护由专业工程师审批
points.K5: 最常见的危害：土体失稳
points.S1: 实验前的五分钟安全提醒

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着安全帽站在围挡外，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears a hard hat, stands outside a construction fence and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天的测验：开挖安全！

shots.scene: 实验楼旁挖开一条管沟，围着围挡
shots.prompt_en: A trench is being dug beside a laboratory building, surrounded by a fence. No people.
shots.narration: 实验楼旁要铺新管道，挖了一条沟。

shots.scene: 阿杰好奇地趴在围挡上往下看
shots.prompt_en: The young male student leans over the fence curiously to look into the trench.
shots.narration: 阿杰好奇，趴在围挡上往下看。

shots.scene: 老李把他拉回来，递给他一张答题卡
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer pulls him back gently and hands him a blank quiz card.
shots.narration: 老李说：先答几道题，就知道危险了。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过
shots.scene: 空白测验框：十个进度格和计时器
shots.prompt_en: A blank quiz panel with ten progress segments and a countdown timer. No people.
shots.narration: 十道题十分钟，答对八题才过。
overlay: 测验规则：十题八对才过

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过
shots.scene: 返回键和重做键
shots.prompt_en: Two button icons: a back arrow and a restart arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 可以回看修改，交卷看答案再重做。

shots.scene: 工人围成一圈听老李讲话
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer gives a short briefing to a small group of workers in hard hats beside the trench.
shots.narration: 开挖前先培训，开个班前安全会。

shots.scene: 安全帽、反光背心、安全鞋、空白规章手册
shots.prompt_en: A hard hat, a high visibility vest, safety boots and a blank regulations booklet laid out. No people.
shots.narration: 配齐安全装备，跟上最新法规。

shots.scene: 新来的工人在登记处听交底
shots.prompt_en: A new worker in a hard hat listens to the facility engineer at a site entrance table.
shots.narration: 到了新工地，也要先接受交底。

shots.section_title: 深基坑支护由专业工程师审批
shots.scene: 深坑边的支护板，旁边一张空白图纸
shots.prompt_en: Shoring panels along a deep pit with a blank engineering drawing beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第一题：深基坑支护谁来审批？
overlay: 深基坑支护由专业工程师审批

shots.section_title: 深基坑支护由专业工程师审批
shots.scene: 路人、家属、普通工人图标打叉，工程师图标圈出
shots.prompt_en: Three person icons crossed out with red X marks; an engineer icon with a hard hat and drawing is circled. No people.
shots.narration: 专业工程师，不是随便谁说了算。

shots.section_title: 深基坑支护由专业工程师审批
shots.scene: 王老师查看空白方案和签字栏
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator reviews a blank plan with signature boxes.
shots.narration: 国内深基坑还要专项方案，按规定审批。

shots.scene: 沟壁斜面示意，旁边一把尺
shots.prompt_en: A simple cross-section of a trench with sloped walls and a ruler icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：放坡规则说的是什么？

shots.scene: 英尺数字卡片打叉
shots.prompt_en: Number cards with foot marks are crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 原题用英尺，我们不照搬数字。

shots.scene: 土质类别图标和施工方案
shots.prompt_en: Three soil type icons beside a blank construction plan. No people.
shots.narration: 坡度和支护，按土质、深度和方案定。

shots.section_title: 最常见的危害：土体失稳
shots.scene: 沟壁上的土开始掉落
shots.prompt_en: Soil starts crumbling from the wall of a trench. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：开挖最常见的危害？
overlay: 最常见的危害：土体失稳

shots.section_title: 最常见的危害：土体失稳
shots.scene: 太阳、咖啡杯、静音图标打叉，塌方图标圈出
shots.prompt_en: A sun, a coffee cup and a mute icon crossed out; a collapsing trench icon is circled. No people.
shots.narration: 土体失稳塌方，能瞬间埋人。

shots.scene: 老李拿着检查表绕沟一圈
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer walks around the trench with a blank checklist.
shots.narration: 第四题：进入开挖现场之前做什么？

shots.scene: 检查要点图标：裂缝、积水、堆土、管线
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a crack, standing water, a soil pile near the edge and an underground pipe. No people.
shots.narration: 看裂缝、积水、堆土和管线。

shots.scene: 媒体、茶点图标打叉
shots.prompt_en: A camera icon and a snack plate icon, both crossed out with red X marks. No people.
shots.narration: 先查隐患，其他事都往后放。

shots.scene: 人字拖、运动鞋、凉鞋排成一排
shots.prompt_en: A pair of flip-flops, a pair of sneakers and a pair of sandals in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：开挖作业穿什么鞋？

shots.scene: 三双鞋打叉，一双安全鞋圈出
shots.prompt_en: The three pairs are crossed out; a pair of steel-toed safety boots is circled in green. No people.
shots.narration: 穿防砸防刺的安全鞋。

shots.section_title: 测验规则：十题八对才过
shots.scene: 阿杰的答题卡全是对勾
shots.prompt_en: The young male student shows a completed answer card full of green checks.
shots.narration: 阿杰这回全答对了。

shots.section_title: 实验前的五分钟安全提醒
shots.scene: 实验室里老周召集大家围在实验台前
shots.prompt_en: In a laboratory, the older man gathers the students around a bench before starting work.
shots.narration: 工地有班前会，实验室也可以有。
overlay: 实验前的五分钟安全提醒

shots.section_title: 实验前的五分钟安全提醒
shots.scene: 白板上三格：今天做什么、危险在哪、出事怎么办
shots.prompt_en: A whiteboard with three blank boxes and icons: a flask, a warning triangle and a first aid cross. No people.
shots.narration: 做什么、危险在哪、出事怎么办。

shots.section_title: 实验前的五分钟安全提醒
shots.scene: 阿杰举手提问
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand to ask a question.
shots.narration: 有疑问当场问，五分钟就够。

shots.scene: 烈日下老李满头大汗在沟边作业
shots.prompt_en: Under a blazing sun, the facility engineer sweats heavily while working beside the trench.
shots.narration: 夏天户外作业，要防中暑。

shots.scene: 遮阳棚下摆着饮用水
shots.prompt_en: A shade tent with bottles of drinking water on a table. No people.
shots.narration: 备好遮阳和饮水，勤喝水。

shots.scene: 老李在阴凉处休息，同伴换班
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer rests in the shade while a coworker takes over.
shots.narration: 轮换作业，避开最热的时段。

shots.scene: 头晕恶心的图标，旁边是电话 120
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a dizzy person beside a phone icon. No people.
shots.narration: 头晕恶心马上停下，严重拨120。

shots.scene: 实验楼走廊地面的电缆沟盖板被掀开
shots.prompt_en: A floor cable trench cover is lifted open in a laboratory corridor. No people.
shots.narration: 实验楼里，地面开口也像一个小坑。

shots.scene: 开口四周立起围挡和警示牌
shots.prompt_en: Barriers and a warning sign are placed around the open floor hatch. No people.
shots.narration: 盖板打开，四周要围挡、挂警示。

shots.scene: 完工后盖板盖好，围挡撤走
shots.prompt_en: The cover is closed and secured, and the barriers are removed. No people.
shots.narration: 干完立刻盖好，不留空洞。

shots.scene: 一排图标：方案、检查表、支护、安全鞋
shots.prompt_en: A row of icons: a blank plan, a checklist, shoring panels and safety boots. No people.
shots.narration: 有方案、先检查、防塌方、穿好鞋。

shots.scene: 阿杰远离围挡，和老李一起走开
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walks away from the fence together with the facility engineer.
shots.narration: 沟边不趴不探，绕行围挡外。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye in front of the construction fence.
shots.narration: 开挖有危险，围挡外面最安全！
